notes: V4 (2026-10-29). Printed: '{T}: Add one mana of any color.' CR 105.1 / 106.1a: the colors are white, blue, black, red and green; colorless is not a color. Mana abilities are no menu rows (2026-11-11): a game activates one only while a cost is paid, the payer choosing the source and its colour (CR 605.3a), so the pack pays through a cast with "tap": true or the menu (act). So no game asks the colour any more: the payer taps one Meteorite for the {W} of Selfless Savior, and the other stays untapped. The ask's five words (never C) are pinned where the engine still asks it: test_executor_legality TestActivateFold.test_any_colour_offers_the_five_colours_only.
